description: Process a holds a dbPessimistic Edit on a row of table U. Process b, with errors recorded, tries ALTER TABLE U ADD COLUMN, CREATE INDEX and DROP TABLE U. Process a then calls CancelUpdate (recordset still open) and b tries ADD COLUMN and CREATE INDEX with new names; a closes the recordset and b tries ADD COLUMN, CREATE INDEX and DROP TABLE U again, then reads the field names. Asks what a row edit lock does and does not protect against DDL from another process.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
